# Data Slayer Tutorials

> Practical, copy-paste tutorials for scraping and automating social platforms with Apify actors — no login required.

## What this site is

Step-by-step guides for using Apify actors to collect public data from LinkedIn, Instagram,
Facebook, TikTok and X, and to automate those flows with n8n, Make, or Zapier.

## Key pages

- Home: https://mayankchaba.github.io/data-slayer-tutorials/
- Tutorials index: https://mayankchaba.github.io/data-slayer-tutorials/
- Sitemap: https://mayankchaba.github.io/data-slayer-tutorials/sitemap.xml

## Actors referenced

- LinkedIn actors: https://apify.com/data-slayer?utm_source=github&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=hub
- Instagram actors: https://apify.com/data-slayer?utm_source=github&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=hub
- Facebook / TikTok / X actors: https://apify.com/data-slayer?utm_source=github&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=hub

## Notes

- All tutorials use Apify actors; no login/cookies are required for the public-data flows.
- Contact: Mayank Chaba.
